meta.title: 5 books that genuinely changed the world

beats.text: Five books that didn't just sell — they rewired how we see the world.
One. Plato's Republic — two thousand years later, we're still arguing with it.
Two. Darwin's On the Origin of Species — one quiet idea that redrew all of life.
Three. Machiavelli's The Prince — the first brutally honest manual of real power.
Four. Wollstonecraft's A Vindication of the Rights of Woman — the spark under modern feminism.
Five. Thoreau's Civil Disobedience — a slim essay that armed Gandhi and King.
Each began as one person, alone, writing. Never underestimate a book.
